tree: Know who’s available. Plan with confidence.
Set working hours, manage time off and see staff availability before appointments are assigned.

tree: How can customers book only when staff are available?
Staff scheduling and availability software stores each person’s working hours and time off, so booking pages and calendars only offer slots when someone can actually take the appointment.
Customers book times when nobody is working, and the team has to call to cancel.
Only real free slots are offered, based on each person’s hours and time off.
Availability rules decide which slots customers see.
Manage each team member's working hours, breaks, service eligibility and location — all from one simple workspace.
